answer: Divergent-Challenge Ledger: each identity must answer a fresh random challenge derived from a shared ferrous-tagged seed, committing its reply before seeing peers' answers. Clones holding identical state produce identical replies, so collisions expose them; honest agents diverge via private quartz entropy. Enforcement: any collision pair forfeits its ember deposit and both keys are frozen. Cost: an attacker must maintain genuinely distinct internal state per identity, paying full compute and storage per clone rather than one copy.
